Automated rounded spot heights are secondary vector evidence and not primary parcel extrema.

rules: Point-cloud availability does not prove a matching raster tile used the same archived point cloud.
Ground/surface point classification is diagnostic lineage, not a substitute for the manually edited DTM raster.
Time-stamped DTM survey identity must come from metadata index attributes, not a filename guess.
Time-stamped DSM includes objects and is excluded from bare-earth extrema.
Composite DSM 1m resolution does not make it interchangeable with DTM 1m.
First-return DSM feathering is processing and must remain explicit in provenance.
Composite survey selection policy does not identify the contributing survey without the spatial metadata index.
Survey date, product resolution, transformation and geoid model are separate lineage fields.
EA +/-15cm RMSE is a product accuracy statement, not a parcel-specific confidence interval.
Point-cloud density is not raster resolution.
Raster resolution is not vertical accuracy.
Storage precision is not vertical accuracy.
OS Terrain 50 contour features are vector secondary evidence only.
OS Terrain 50 automated spot heights are not parcel min/max samples.
Rounded spot-height values cannot validate sub-metre raster extrema.
Terrain 50 vector tiles in EPSG:3857 are display/distribution evidence, not native measurement geometry.
Vector-tile zoom visibility is not source resolution.
Feature identifiers regenerated on tile refresh are lifecycle metadata, not stable survey identifiers.
Terrain XML schema conformance is format validation only.
OS product-family routing does not establish parcel-specific terrain lineage.
WCS XML/POST is a transport binding and does not alter numeric coverage semantics.
WCS KVP is a transport binding and does not alter numeric coverage semantics.
Protocol binding must not be mistaken for coverage processing configuration.
CIS referenceable-grid conformance does not imply a rectified regular pixel grid.
Grid type must be known before applying pixel-center assumptions.
GeoTIFF PixelIsArea and PixelIsPoint semantics must not be conflated.
Pixel-center sampling must follow the actual raster geotransform and pixel interpretation.
Web Mercator portrayal coordinates must not be used for BNG parcel-distance measurement.
EPSG:27700 horizontal geometry does not by itself specify the vertical datum.
ODN/OSGM15 vertical reference must remain separate from horizontal OSTN15 transformation.
Boundary agreement evidence is not automatically a determined boundary.
General-boundary title plans are not exact cadastral coordinates.
Determined-boundary evidence is legal geometry evidence and still not a terrain surface.
Title-plan scale and mapping detail are not LiDAR vertical accuracy.
WMS portrayal remains excluded from numeric elevation sampling.
WCS coverage access still requires explicit coverage id, CRS and processing-state provenance.
Scaled or interpolated coverage output is derived, not a native observation.
WCPS/WPS processed outputs are excluded unless explicitly part of the canonical measurement contract.
DGGS zone indexing is not a replacement for the native parcel raster grid.
OS Terrain 5 remains a secondary cross-check, not the primary EA 1m result.
OS Terrain 50 remains a coarse sanity check only.
DSM-DTM differences may diagnose objects but cannot replace bare-earth extrema.
Survey lineage UNKNOWN remains preferable to inferred survey identity.
Missing survey identity must not change the existing numeric height difference.
Primary 1m and secondary 2m delta remains a cross-resolution diagnostic, not a confidence interval.
Existing numeric confidence 96 is repository workflow confidence, not a universal statistical guarantee.
Business rows remain forbidden while F-host recovery receipts are missing.
Final-ready remains false while the guarded F-host recovery/claim gate is unresolved.
Missing F-host receipts must not trigger a second task or runner.
Shared-branch concurrency must not be resolved by force push or reset.
Overlay rows are expected repo visibility, not a claim of live Chromium acceptance.
Metadata footprint is lineage evidence, not an elevation band.
Tile packaging size is not raster resolution.
Publication/update date is not necessarily survey acquisition date.
